content.bridge_context: We look at the Vedic period through the oldest literary source, the Rigveda, and through Megaliths (large stone burials) that tell us about social differences.

units.title: The Vedas
units.explanation: Vedas are ancient holy books. The Rigveda is the oldest, containing hymns (Suktas) praising gods like Agni, Indra, and Soma.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss how hymns were passed down by memory. / चर्चा करें कि कैसे भजनों को याद करके आगे बढ़ाया गया।

units.title: Megaliths and Social Status
units.explanation: Megaliths are huge stone boulders used to mark burial sites. The objects found in these graves tell us who was rich or poor.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify signs of wealth in a grave (Gold beads vs. Pots). / कब्र में धन के संकेतों (सोने के मोती बनाम बर्तन) की पहचान करें।
